description: Figure 5 presents an error analysis comparing the Vanilla model and the HCL model, visualized as two pie charts displayed side-by-side. The pie chart for the Vanilla model contains five slices, labeled “AddSub”, “MixMul”, “MixAll”, “ST”, and “AL”, appearing to be ordered from largest to smallest segment. These slices are colored dark blue, light blue, green, orange, and red respectively, and represent approximately 60%, 25%, 5%, 5%, and 5% of the total, respectively. The pie chart for the HCL model also contains five slices, labeled “ST-AllSub”, “ST-Overall”, “HCL-RAW”, “HCL-RAM”, and “HCL-AL”, also appearing to be ordered from largest to smallest segment. These slices are colored orange, dark blue, light blue, green, and red respectively, and represent approximately 70%, 15%, 5%, 5%, and 5% of the total, respectively. Both charts include a legend identifying the slice labels and corresponding colors. Percentage labels are not displayed directly within the slices themselves.
